# Genesis Apocryphon Column 13 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QapGen (Cave 1), Col. 13 | **Condition:** Nearly destroyed; only scattered words survive

---

**13:1** [...] Shem [...] his-portion [...] of-the-land [...]

**13:2** [...] from [...] the-river-Tigris to [...] the-east [...]

**13:3** [...] and-all the-land of [...] the-mountains [...]

**13:4** [...] to-the-sea [...] the-great [...] and-to the-south [...]

**13:5** [...] the-garden-of-Eden [...] was-in the-portion of-Shem [...]

**13:6** [...] and-all the-land of [...] his-inheritance forever [...]

**13:7** [...]

**13:8** [...]

---

*EMET notes: Column 13 is nearly destroyed. Surviving fragments describe Shem's territorial allotment, which traditionally encompassed the central lands including Mesopotamia and the Levant. The mention of the Garden of Eden within Shem's portion parallels Jubilees 8:12-21. Aramaic construct chains rendered with hyphens.*
